activity.notes: Contemporary diplomatic chronology associates Manso with his father Sergius I in the government of Amalfi from 958 to 966. This co-ducal phase is separated from Manso's full ducal succession in 966.

sources.title: Mansóne I duca di Amalfi — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Manso's rule with his father, sole rule from 966, co-rule with his son through 984, interruption under Adelterio around 984–988, and restored rule until 1004.

sources.title: Codice diplomatico Amalfitano
sources.citation_text: The diplomatic chronology lists Sergius with his son Manso in 958–966, Manso as duke 966–976, with John 976–984, and Manso's later restored rule; it also records his princely rule in Salerno.

sources.title: Mansone — Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani, Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani's biographical entry records Manso's seizure and princely rule of Salerno beginning in 981 and his deposition there by late 983.
